data.desc: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. (Nasdaq: SCNI) is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative therapies for inflammation and immunology. Its wholly owned subsidiary, Scinai Biopharma Services Ltd. , operates a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), serving biotechnology and pharmaceutical customers through facilities in Jerusalem and Yavne, Israel . The Company develops its NanoAb platform through research collaboration and license arrangements with the Max Planck Society and University Medical Center Göttingen in Germany . For more information, visit www.scinai.com .
